title: 第13章 武者之路第14章 实力蜕变三更求月票
content_zh:
;;
“这么快就买好了？”方羽心中惊讶于父亲的购物速度。
咔~
方平安已经打开箱子，先是取出五件精致无比的玉瓶，还有两大盒密封完好的药剂，上面标注着‘星河集团’的字样。
“细胞活力素？”方羽一眼认出了其中一盒药剂。
“嗯。”
“你也是大专生，这两种药剂应该都认识，细胞活力素、生机再生剂，各有六支。”方平安指着两盒药剂。
方羽心中狠狠颤了下。
他怎么可能不知？
大专里，他也有一位富豪同学，偶尔便会使用这两种高级药剂，对身体的淬炼效果远在气血合剂、壮骨丹之上。
因此，哪怕对方修炼不算刻苦，技艺天赋也一般般，可生命层次却极为不俗，大三期末考核便是18级，位列生命层次前十。
可价格，也很惊人。
细胞活力素、生机再生剂，都只有八大集团才能稳定出品的高级药剂，一支便要5万星币。
父亲拿出的这12支，总价值便是60万星币。
“这两种药剂，搭配使用效果最好，正常来说，初级武者们，十天才能服用一支，再多便会浪费大量药效甚至对身体补过头，过犹不及。”方平安道：“但你掌控身体入微大成，淬炼效率高得多。”
“一个月时间，应该刚好够用。”
方平安没有给方羽具体服用时间，技艺入微大成者，感应自身情况能力极强，自己决定就好。
药剂的使用情况，都是因人而异。
“这两种药剂，再搭配少量气血合剂、壮骨丹，能最大效率加快你生命层次提升。”方平安道。
“最重要的，还是这东西。”

方平安指着五个玉瓶，他打开其中一个玉瓶，瓶内散发着一阵阵寒意，有着一枚大拇指大小的果实，表层宛若寒冰般。
“这是冰心洗髓果？”方羽迟疑道。
“在学校的《天材地宝》课程倒是没白学，竟然能认出来。”方平安露出笑意。
强大武者，未来都是要闯荡原初星的。
作为武者战场，原初星蕴藏着无数天材地宝……这么多年下来，为了让新生代武者闯荡原初星时不错过宝物。
所有武道大专生、本科生，都是要必修《天材地宝》这门课。
至少要会认，会保存。
“爸。”方羽忍不住道：“这五个玉瓶，是五枚冰心洗髓果吗？”
方平安点头。
方羽心中屏息，冰心洗髓果，和万象化生果一样，都是用来夯实根基的。
但万象化生果的效力极为温和，会在长达数个月时间里，逐渐释放药力，最适合武道初学者……对初级武者就比较鸡肋了。
而冰心洗髓果，则是一种药效更为霸道的筑基宝物，主要适用对象是黄金年龄段的初级武者。
也正因效果太霸道。
许多初级武者不愿购买，它的价格不是太高，但这所谓‘不高’也是相对的，五枚加起来也要近200万星币。
“你入微大成，才能使用。”
“加上你大专三年，没用过其他筑基宝物，效果应该不错。”方平安道：“一个月内全部服下，也能弥补你几分根基。”
“说起来，你高中时，没给你用万象化生果，是我的错。”方平安轻叹了声。
当年。

"You bought it so quickly?" Fang Yu was surprised at his father's shopping speed.
Click~
Fang Ping'an had already opened the box and took out five exquisite jade bottles and two large boxes of well-sealed potions with the words 'Galaxy Group' on them.
"Cytovitin?" Fang Yu recognized one of the boxes of medicine at a glance.
"Yeah."
"You are also a junior college student. You should be familiar with these two medicines. There are six each of cell activator and vitality regeneration agent." Fang Ping'an pointed to two boxes of medicines.
Fang Yu's heart trembled.
How could he not know?
In junior college, he also had a wealthy classmate who would occasionally use these two high-level pharmaceuticals. Their tempering effect on the body was far greater than that of Qi and Blood Mixture and Bone Strengthening Pill.
Therefore, even if the other party does not practice hard and has average skills and talents, his life level is extremely good. In the final assessment of his junior year, he was level 18, ranking among the top ten in life level.
But the price is also amazing.
Cell activators and vitality regenerating agents are high-end pharmaceuticals that only the eight major groups can stably produce. Each bottle costs 50,000 star coins.
The total value of these 12 pieces that my father took out was 600,000 star coins.
"These two potions have the best effect when used together. Normally, junior warriors can only take one potion every ten days. Any more will waste a lot of potency and even over-supply the body, which is not enough." Fang Ping'an said: "But if you control the body to a great extent, the tempering efficiency is much higher."
"One month should be enough."
Fang Ping'an did not give Fang Yu a specific time to take it. Those who have mastered the skills have a strong ability to sense their own situation, so they can make their own decisions.
The usage of medicines varies from person to person.
"These two medicines, combined with a small amount of Qi and Blood Mixture and Bone Strengthening Pill, can speed up your life level improvement to the maximum efficiency." Fang Ping'an said.
"The most important thing is this."
Fang Pingan pointed to the five jade bottles. He opened one of the jade bottles. There was a chill inside the bottle. There was a fruit the size of a thumb, and the surface was like ice.
"Is this the Bingxin Marrow Cleansing Fruit?" Fang Yu hesitated.
"I didn't learn the "Treasures of Heaven and Earth" course in school, and I can actually recognize it." Fang Ping'an smiled.
Powerful warriors will conquer the original star in the future.
As a battlefield for warriors, the Primordial Star contains countless treasures of heaven and earth... Over the years, in order to allow the new generation of warriors to explore the Primordial Star without missing any treasures.
All martial arts college and undergraduate students must take the course "Treasures of Heaven, Materials and Earth".
At least you must be able to recognize it and save it.
"Dad." Fang Yu couldn't help but said, "Are these five jade vases five Ice Heart Marrow Washing Fruits?"
Fang Pingan nodded.
Fang Yu held his breath in his heart, and the Bing Xin Marrow Washing Fruit, like the Vientiane Transformation Fruit, was used to solidify the foundation.
However, the effect of the Vientiane Transformation Fruit is extremely mild, and it will gradually release its medicinal power over a period of several months. It is most suitable for martial arts beginners... but it is useless for junior warriors.
The Bingxin Marrow Cleansing Fruit is a foundation-building treasure with more powerful medicinal effects. It is mainly suitable for junior warriors in the golden age group.
It is precisely because the effect is too overbearing.
Many junior warriors are unwilling to buy it. Its price is not too high, but the so-called "not high" is relative. The five pieces in total cost nearly 2 million star coins.
"You can only use it if you have mastered it."
"In addition, you have been in college for three years and have not used other foundation-building treasures, so the effect should be good." Fang Ping'an said: "Taking them all within a month can also make up for your foundation."
"Speaking of which, it was my fault that I didn't give you the Vientiane Transformation Fruit when you were in high school." Fang Ping'an sighed softly.
